name: 화염폭풍

playModeNote: Recommended: play BOTH layers: the full-screen overlay once, plus the per-unit impact on every unit on both boards, each started at its own delay. overlay.fit: stretch to the full 16:9 stage (1920x1080 at 1080p), top-left 0,0
